report:
Reviewed the complete meta.reviews.validation_layout claim, its one ordinary implementation association in crates/sage-meta/src/review.rs, and both ordinary associated test functions. No TODO or N/A entries exist. Additional captured dependencies are the fixture/setup helpers in tests/review.rs lines 1–103, valid_anchor_name in spec.rs lines 248–257, and the review-gate integration in check.rs lines 443–500.

The complete dotted ID determines exactly one validations/<anchor> path through anchor_directory; valid_anchor_name accepts nonempty ASCII identifier components separated by dots. start validates the ID and current specification inventory, takes the parent lock, removes the existing entire anchor directory, recreates it, and writes input.json containing captured context plus summary.json containing the anchor identity. It does not write output.json. Thus previous reports and previous captured context are discarded instead of retained as historical versions. read_summary rejects an identity different from the directory name; load_saved rejects invalid directory names and non-directory entries and requires the summary/input files. record writes the completed ValidationOutput to output.json and marks completion in the summary. load_saved only exposes completed output after that completion metadata exists; validate reports unfinished reviews when output is absent, and acceptable requires completed output. These paths account for identity, the three files and their roles, reset behavior, and failure to satisfy the gate until recording completes.

start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required exercises the full lifecycle against a concrete demo.rule fixture: the initial gate fails, approval passes, a second start returns the exact saved input, summary identifies demo.rule with a null recording timestamp, output.json is physically absent, and both the shared check and loaded record show an unfinished review. An additional captured read cannot make it pass. Recording preserves input bytes, sets recording time, and makes the shared gate pass; another record/read is rejected after completion. This would detect retention of an older approval or a start that accidentally writes a completed report. completed_corrupt_records_and_invalid_layout_cannot_pass starts from successful records and removes summary, input, or output, introduces a non-directory entry, or corrupts output format. Both shared and CLI checks must fail with anchor-specific layout diagnostics. The tests collectively exercise the declared layout and its gate consequences; explicit summary identity assertion plus source inspection of read_summary and valid_anchor_name establish the identity constraint without treating every metadata field as requiring an isolated test.

Assessment is source inspection, including complete supplied fragments and captured helper fragments; no behavior or production source was edited. Commands I executed were cargo meta review start and cargo meta review read for the dependencies, followed by this report recording. I did not rerun functional suites or cargo build. Coordinator-reported functional tests and build success are separate execution evidence, not commands run by this reviewer. No substantive implementation or test adequacy issue was found for this claim.
